instruction: Candid documentary medium shot of an indoor room near a window. On the left, the woman with curly hair (R1) in a blue corduroy jacket and green pants sits cross-legged, looking down with a somber expression. On the right, the woman with straight dark hair (R2) in a dark green sweater and jeans sits with her chin resting on her hand, looking down sadly. The woman with curly hair (R1) keeps her left hand comfortingly on the other woman's shoulder. Soft natural light from the window illuminates the scene with cool, muted tones.
